# Telemetry names
#
# Generated by `pnpm telemetry-surface:generate` from the source that emits them. ADR 0054
# governs this surface and ADR 0048 places it in the OpenTelemetry adapter: a removed or renamed
# instrument, span, or attribute is breaking, as is a changed unit or kind, and an addition is
# not. Log event names are not listed, because WorkhorseLogEvent is an exported union and
# api/typescript.txt already prints every member.

## Instruments

# name  kind  unit  description

workhorse.claim.duration                         histogram         ms            PostgreSQL claim operation latency
workhorse.deadline.overdue                       gauge             {job}         Current live jobs past their absolute deadline
workhorse.execution_timeout.overdue              gauge             {attempt}     Current active attempts past their execution timeout
workhorse.handler.batch.linger                   histogram         ms            Time from the first batch member arriving until dispatch
workhorse.handler.batch.size                     histogram         {job}         Jobs delivered in one batch handler invocation
workhorse.handler.duration                       histogram         ms            Handler execution latency
workhorse.handler.executions                     counter           {execution}   Worker handler activations by outcome
workhorse.handler.runtime                        counter           ms            Cumulative handler execution time
workhorse.jobs.cancellation                      counter           {request}     Job cancellation requests by durable result
workhorse.jobs.claimed                           counter           {job}         Jobs claimed for handler execution
workhorse.jobs.completed                         counter           {job}         Jobs completed under a valid lease
workhorse.jobs.count                             gauge             {job}         Current live jobs by queue and runtime state
workhorse.jobs.enqueue.outcomes                  counter           {request}     Enqueue requests by PostgreSQL acceptance outcome
workhorse.jobs.enqueued                          counter           {job}         Jobs accepted for durable execution
workhorse.jobs.failed                            counter           {job}         Handler failures submitted to PostgreSQL
workhorse.jobs.redrive                           counter           {request}     Job redrive requests by durable result
workhorse.jobs.retried                           counter           {job}         Failed or expired jobs returned to live work
workhorse.lease.expired                          gauge             {lease}       Current active leases past their expiry time
workhorse.leases.expired                         counter           {lease}       Expired leases recovered by maintenance
workhorse.maintenance.drift                      histogram         ms            Delay beyond a worker maintenance loop's configured cadence
workhorse.maintenance.duration                   histogram         ms            Workhorse maintenance phase duration
workhorse.maintenance.errors                     counter           {error}       Workhorse maintenance phase failures
workhorse.maintenance.rows                       counter           {row}         Rows affected by Workhorse maintenance phases
workhorse.maintenance.runs                       counter           {run}         Workhorse maintenance phase executions
workhorse.queue.children.canceled_parents        observable_gauge  {job}         Retained parents canceled by linked child policy
workhorse.queue.children.capped                  observable_gauge  1             Whether child orchestration values reached their scan limit
workhorse.queue.children.failed_parents          observable_gauge  {job}         Retained parents failed by linked child policy
workhorse.queue.children.pending                 observable_gauge  {job}         Linked children without a terminal outcome
workhorse.queue.children.unjoined_results        observable_gauge  {result}      Successful child results not yet consumed by their parent
workhorse.queue.children.waiting_parents         observable_gauge  {job}         Parents suspended while linked children settle
workhorse.queue.concurrency.active               observable_gauge  {job}         Unexpired active jobs counted by queue concurrency admission
workhorse.queue.concurrency.blocked_ready        observable_gauge  {job}         Bounded ready depth blocked by queue concurrency policy
workhorse.queue.concurrency.limit                observable_gauge  {job}         Configured queue concurrency limit
workhorse.queue.dependencies.blocked             observable_gauge  {job}         Jobs waiting for prerequisite policy resolution
workhorse.queue.dependencies.capped              observable_gauge  1             Whether dependency pressure values reached their scan limit
workhorse.queue.dependencies.failed_resolutions  observable_gauge  {job}         Retained jobs failed by dependency policy
workhorse.queue.dependencies.pending_edges       observable_gauge  {edge}        Unresolved prerequisite edges
workhorse.queue.depth                            observable_gauge  {job}         Current live work by dispatch state
workhorse.queue.oldest_ready.age                 gauge             s             Age of the oldest ready job
workhorse.queue.oldest_ready_age                 observable_gauge  ms            Age of the oldest ready job
workhorse.queue.paused                           gauge             1             Whether dispatch is paused for a queue
workhorse.queue.rate_limit.available_tokens      observable_gauge  {token}       Refilled queue start tokens available now
workhorse.queue.rate_limit.configured            observable_gauge  {job}/s       Configured sustained queue start rate
workhorse.queue.rate_limit.next_eligible_delay   observable_gauge  ms            Delay until the earliest sampled throttled job can start
workhorse.queue.rate_limit.throttled_ready       observable_gauge  {job}         Bounded ready depth waiting for rate-limit tokens
workhorse.schedule.fired                         counter           {occurrence}  Recurring schedule occurrences durably fired
workhorse.schedule.lag                           histogram         s             Delay between a scheduled occurrence and its durable firing
workhorse.wait.delivery.rejected                 gauge             {delivery}    Rejected signal deliveries and human-wait completions in the trailing 24 hours
workhorse.wait.overdue                           gauge             {wait}        Current signal and human waits past their effective PostgreSQL timeout
workhorse.wait.pending                           gauge             {wait}        Current signal and human waits that still own a live suspension boundary
workhorse.worker.active                          gauge             {slot}        Occupied worker execution slots
workhorse.worker.capacity                        gauge             {slot}        Declared worker execution slots
workhorse.worker.count                           gauge             {worker}      Registered workers by queue and runtime state
workhorse.worker.heartbeat.failure               counter           {heartbeat}   Worker heartbeats rejected by PostgreSQL ownership or timing checks
